description: Sign the user out. By default signs out of every restaurant; pass a clientId to sign out of one, and an account label to sign out just that account.

clientId.description: clientId of the restaurant to sign out of. Omit to sign out everywhere.

label.description: Account label to sign out, e.g. 'work'. Omit to sign out every account at that restaurant.

name: logout
title: Sign out
